chunks: Sulaimān ibn Jaʿfar al-Jaʿfarī narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him saying: “Whoever approaches his wife during the moon’s dark phase at the end of the month, then let him resign himself to the miscarriage of the child.”

key_terms.أَتَى أَهْلَهُ: approached his wife for marital relations
key_terms.سِقْطِ: miscarriage or loss before full birth
key_terms.فَلْيُسَلِّمْ: let him submit or resign himself
key_terms.مُحَاقِ: the moon’s darkened phase at the end of the lunar month

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about intercourse during the dark phase of the lunar month?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a discouragement regarding marital relations during مُحَاقِ الشَّهْرِ, the dark phase at the end of the lunar month. It presents this time as associated with harm, specifically the risk of miscarriage, within the context of family-related legal etiquette.
